title: Kanmani Anbudan
episodeTitle: Vennila Hatches a Plan Against Anbu
description: Anbu is frustrated when Rajeshwari includes Vennila in the company anniversary celebration. Vennila secretly collects his fingerprints to access his mobile and carry out her plan.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma sends Ilamathi and Paraman to Yercaud for honeymoon, secretly plotting with Rishi to kill Ilamathi. Joined by Nalini and Siddharth, Ilamathi enjoys the trip and is excited by her hotel room.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Prabhakaran's plan backfires as Karna collapses before confessing, while Vetri and Divya record his confession. Later, Vetri and Prabhakaran plan to obtain evidence using Manickam.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Meenatchi comforts Nandhini over her failed love and assures her of a better future. Meanwhile, Azhagar is touched by Pechi's care as she fans him during the power cut.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Thangaraj vents to Ragavan about Revathi's phone addiction and fears she may change like other wives. Meanwhile, Shruthi rejects a marriage proposal.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Suganya's bangle ceremony is filled with joy as Muthuvel's family adorns her with bangles and blesses her. Later, Palanivel feels relieved when she leaves for her mother's home.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Worried Thenmozhi urges Nila to move back home with Chozhan before taking her leave. Nila confronts Chozhan over cheap bangles, then joins Cheran in comforting Chandayatha.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu shares a thoughtful story about a room with Meena. Meanwhile, Rohini pressures Manoj to attend a temple pooja, threatening to expose his neglect of her.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Neethiman asks Eshwari to manipulate Sethupathi into approving a contract for his friend Sadhasivam. Later, Sethupathi requests Tamizhselvi to give Meenakshi instead of Azhagar.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Karthik politely asks Kasthuri to hide their marriage from the college. Later, while working overtime together, Madhu notices Arjun's positive change in character.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Indhira recalls cherished childhood memories with Murugan, who makes her room memorable with sweet romantic gestures. Kumaran and Sarasu praise their loving, kind-hearted bond.
